title: Tribes coordinate indexing
statement: For natural numbers $w$ and $s$, identify the $sw$ coordinates with pairs $(b,j)$ where $b\in\{0,\ldots,s-1\}$ and $j\in\{0,\ldots,w-1\}$ by the usual indexing of a product of finite sets. The coordinate map sends each index to its corresponding pair.
